text:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired for streaming-sse-prod: p99 latency breach (>3s) on /v1/stream/generate, sustained for 6m. Paging on-call.

alice: got the page, grabbing dashboards + traces now. switching to oncall channel.

raj: I’m oncall. seeing p95 jump from ~200ms to ~1.2s, p99 ~6s across eu-west-1 and us-central. throughput steady.

raj: quick health checks — streaming-proxy pod CPU normal, net I/O fine. Connection counts up ~18%.

sam: looks like a lot of stalled chunk writes on the proxy. grep of logs: 
```
ERROR streaming-proxy: timeout writing chunk: write tcp 10.0.1.45:443->10.1.2.33:51234: write: connection reset by peer
WARN streaming-proxy: client slow consumer, buffering > 8MB
```

miranda: any correlation with recent deploys?~

raj: no deploys in last 2h. autoscale events: none. No config pushes.

ops-bot: Alert: upstream backend queue depth increased for model-runtime-pool-3 by 30% (threshold 20%).

alice: possible two contributors: client backpressure (slow consumers) + proxy write timeouts causing stall buildup. If proxy buffers fill, it stalls other streams -> tail latency.

chris-oncall: are we seeing proxy-level keepalive timeouts? which kernel/OS limits?

raj: checking proxy config: nginx-style keepalive 60s, write_timeout 30s. Some clients hold sockets open but stop reading, causing buffers to grow.

sam: mitigation suggestion 1: toggle aggressive streaming backpressure policy -> drop slow consumers after 10s stall. Suggest enabling for 15 minutes as temporary.

sam: mitigation suggestion 2: roll restart 25% of streaming-proxy pods to clear stuck connections (canary first).

raj: rolling restart started on canary pod streaming-proxy-67c9f.

alice: starting rate-limit rule to soft-throttle heavy connections from origin X (client bucket). applying via edge-ratelimit service.

ops-bot: exec: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/streaming-proxy -n prod --selector=canary=true` ran by raj.

miranda: while restarting canary, I deployed a temporary nginx config to reduce sendfile buffer and shorten `send_timeout` to 10s for canary.

sam: canary results: connection drops for the worst-offending client group, p99 on canary improved from 6s -> 550ms within 90s.

raj: rolling restarts for remaining proxies in waves of 3 pods now. watching error rates.

chris-oncall: customer impact: we saw increased reconnects for streaming sessions. early estimate ~1.1% of active streams experienced stalls/reconnects between 10:12-10:32 UTC. Escalated to CS: CS-1182.

alice: started a temporary model-fallback policy for latency-sensitive routes: if tail > 2s fallback to smaller-quantized model-alpha. This reduces upstream queueing.

sam: after restarts + throttle, p95 back to ~220ms, p99 down to ~780ms. continuing to monitor for 20m.

miranda: logged all implicated client IPs; created blocklist rule to prevent re-acquisition of many concurrent sockets from misbehaving clients. Rule active for 30m.

raj: summary of immediate mitigation actions:
- rolled streaming-proxy canary -> full wave restart
- tightened send_timeout on proxies to 10s for short window
- enabled soft drop of slow consumers after 10s
- applied edge rate-limit for heavy client buckets
- enabled model fallback for latency-sensitive routes

inc-bot: Incident acknowledged. Priority: P2. Incident channel created: #incident-6921122334.

chris-oncall: next oncall handoff to miranda at 11:00 UTC. miranda you'll get full runbook.

miranda: taking handoff. I'll keep monitoring for 2 hours, run a deeper trace to find if specific customers' client SDK versions are correlated.

alice: follow-ups (short term):
- postmortem triage: confirm root cause (proxy config vs client-side behaviour)
- instrument per-socket read throughput metrics in proxy for 1.2 weeks
- add canary config to release notes to avoid config drift

sam: ops follow-ups:
- make send_timeout and slow-consumer thresholds tunable per route
- evaluate automating temporary drop for clients that exceed buffer thresholds

chris-oncall: CS to contact top 3 affected customers, provide mitigations and ETA for fix. Provide them with recommended client SDK patch to enable streaming read buffers.

raj: attaching quick trace snippet for oncall: 
```
trace_id=0xabc123 route=/v1/stream/generate latency=6120ms component=proxy stall_at=kv-cache-write
stack: proxy.WriteLoop -> bufferQueue.Add -> backend.Write -> client.Read stalled
```

miranda: noted. Opening follow-up ticket ENG-4331 for proxy backpressure improvements and ENG-4332 for client SDK guidance.

alice: incident moving to monitor state. If p99 stays <1s for 30m, we'll resolve and start postmortem.

raj: last check: p95=210ms p99=670ms errors back to baseline.

inc-bot: Incident status updated: monitoring -> stable. Incident resolved for paging at 10:46 UTC.

miranda: taking the write-up. I'll add timeline + RCA draft to #postmortems tomorrow.

chris-oncall: closing notes: no code regression identified, combination of misbehaving SDKs + aggressive proxy defaults. need permanent fix before next major load. :white_check_mark:
